SELECT x.product_business_type,SUM(CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) amount,
 COUNT(DISTINCT l.item_code) products,COUNT(*) lines,COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_entry) documents,
 MIN(d.doc_date) first_date,MAX(d.doc_date) last_date
 FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry
 JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') x ON x."ItemCode"=l.item_code
 WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND l.source_table='INV1'
 AND d.canceled='N' AND d.currency='BS' AND l.currency='BS'
 AND d.doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-10-01'
 AND x.product_business_type IN ('RAW_MATERIAL','LAB_FINISHED_PRODUCT')
 GROUP BY x.product_business_type ORDER BY 1
